patches.decision_note: The freelancer's wording indicates a proposed or confirming action, not an explicit claim that the publisher-attribution line was already removed.

ambiguity.description: The client is uncertain whether an image-only cover without title or author text is appropriate for printed presentation.

patches.decision_note: The client observes the image-only draft but asks whether that presentation is expected; the source establishes unresolved cover-content uncertainty rather than a confirmed runtime failure.

Authoritative source-file integration and dedication-page content have independent modifications and failure trajectories. Mama's Hot Take styling and punctuation corrections should remain routed to their narrower Requirements.
Chapter-title styling and table-of-contents presentation are independently testable interior behaviors and should not share one lifecycle.
Placement at chapter openings and use of a full-page treatment can change independently from stretching, cropping, pixelation, and corner-artifact prevention.

replacement.title: Interior Page Numbering
replacement.definition: Add and maintain appropriate page numbers in the paperback interior.

patches.decision_note: The client explicitly requests page numbers, which are independently implementable and verifiable from chapter-heading and table-of-contents formatting.

replacement.title: Paperback Trim Size
replacement.definition: Use the client-selected paperback trim dimensions when preparing publication artifacts.

patches.decision_note: The selected 5.5 by 8.5 inch trim size is an independent production constraint affecting multiple artifacts and should not be duplicated as a cover-design value.

replacement.title: Back Matter and Author Copy
replacement.definition: Prepare the requested back matter or back-cover content and associated author lines, with the exact artifact location requiring clarification.

patches.decision_note: The requested back content and author lines constitute a concrete deliverable distinct from general publishing guidance, although their exact placement remains unresolved.
Determine whether the requested back content belongs inside the book, on the back cover, or in both locations before finalizing its Scope and Family membership.
The accepted cover-file format depends on an unavailable attachment or example and cannot be recovered safely from the supplied message text.
